title: Homepage: Show subscribe button and category list

stories.title: Split s_sidebar blocks so category widget renders independently
acceptanceCriteria: skin.html has two separate <s_sidebar> blocks — one for profile, one for category
The category <s_sidebar_element> contains the sidebar-category div with [##_category_list_##]

stories.title: Category list is visible with # prefix format matching category.png
acceptanceCriteria: CSS hides only the anchor inside .link_tit, not the li container itself (.sidebar-category .link_tit > a and .sidebar-category a.link_tit are display:none)
CSS does NOT have .sidebar-category .link_tit { display: none } (which would hide nested category_list)
JS linkTitEl logic hides only the direct <a> child, not the li container
.sidebar-category a::before adds '#' prefix for category links

stories.title: Subscribe button (구독하기) is visible and styled in profile sidebar
acceptanceCriteria: The button has background: var(--color-accent) !important and color: #fff !important
